cdl_products.2024-2025: NASS official resampled 30 m national CDL (native resolution is 10 m)

analysis_period.cdl_end_year_note: NASS native CDL resolution is 30 m for 2008-2023 and 10 m for 2024 and 2025. The MVP uses a consistent 30 m series: native 30 m for 2008-2023 and the official NASS resampled 30 m national products for 2024-2025. Iowa 2025 files were confirmed downloadable via CropScape on 2026-11-14, but their pixel size has not been verified; do not assume they are 30 m.
